resources.string: Direct one-tap Bluetooth tile for Android 15
Requires Nearby Devices (BLUETOOTH_CONNECT) permission to read connected device names and control Bluetooth.
Add the tile to your Quick Settings panel to toggle Bluetooth directly with a single tap.
Tile is available in Quick Settings
Single-tap toggles Bluetooth directly.\nLong-press opens Bluetooth & BLE device settings.

Android 13+ normally blocks apps from directly enabling or disabling Bluetooth and forces a multi-step popup dialog. By utilizing the proven mechanism discovered in the MacroDroid Connectivity Helper reference, this app leverages Android\'s backward compatibility layer (targetSdk 32) while compiling against the Android 15 SDK (compileSdk 35) to regain instant, one-tap Bluetooth toggling without extra UI.
